Covered. ProductCard renders WishlistButton in the card footer; ProductGrid passes products through unchanged, so every rendered card gets the toggle. The new accentRose token exists only to style that toggle.

notes.types/product.ts#Product: One optional field added, so every consumer still type-checks. Optionality is what makes the misses below silent rather than loud: check each consumer for a read of wishlisted, not for a compile error.
notes.lib/api/products.ts: serializeProduct builds the payload field by field and never mentions wishlisted. Highest-value place to look first: confirm whether the API contract is supposed to carry it.
notes.components/CartItem.tsx: Consumes Product via props and renders price inline. Criterion 3 expects wishlist state here; this file is untouched. Break or intent gap is your call.
notes.pages/SearchResults.tsx: Consumes Product[] for results only; no read of the new field, no expected behaviour change. Drawn so the blast radius is honest.
notes.components/ProductGrid.tsx: Renders ProductCard and forwards products unchanged. The prop contract did not change because the new field is optional.
notes.components/ProductCard.tsx#ProductCard: Adds WishlistButton to the footer, keyed on product.id. Check that the id passed here is the same identity the hook stores, since nothing type-checks that pairing.
notes.components/WishlistButton.tsx#WishlistBu: New component. aria-pressed is present and reflects hook state, so the accessible behaviour is there. Styling reads tokens.accentRose directly rather than a CSS var.
notes.hooks/useWishlist.ts#useWishlist: New hook, localStorage-backed. Two classic failure points in exactly this pattern: the storage key is a bare 'wishlist' with no namespace, and useLocalStore writes to window.localStorage without the SSR guard it uses on read.
notes.styles/tokens.ts#tokens: One token added, consumed only by WishlistButton so far. No other consumer to keep in sync yet.
notes.lib/format.ts#formatPrice: Rewritten from a template string to Intl.NumberFormat with a module-level locale constant. Probably an improvement, but it changes output formatting for every price in the app and matches no criterion.
